definition: Various combination — Śiva's power to combine diverse elements into the world's manifold forms. The world's diversity is not external creation but Śiva's own combination (citrasaṃyojana), displayed as his play.

sources.claim: citrasaṃyojanābhiḥ — with various combinations (the world's diversity is Śiva's own combination)

translations.note: 'Combination' captures saṃyojana; 'various' captures citra. The term implies creative, not mechanical, combination.
